description: Updates the slug for an existing team within a Sentry organization.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating a team's slug.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the organization to which the team belongs.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

slug.description: The new slug for the team. Must be unique within the organization and follow the pattern: starts with a lowercase letter, followed by lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
slug.title: Slug

team_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the team whose slug is to be updated.
team_id_or_slug.title: Team Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: UpdateTeamInformationByOrganizationIdRequest

name: update_team_information_by_organization_id

avatarUrl.description: URL to the avatar image, can be null
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

avatarUuid.description: Avatar UUID identifier, can be null
avatarUuid.title: Avatar Uuid

UpdateTeamInformationByOrganizationIdRes.description: Response model containing the updated team information.

access.description: Array of permission scopes granted to the team
access.title: Access

dateCreated.description: Team creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format
dateCreated.title: Date Created

flags.description: Feature flags object containing team-specific flags
flags.title: Flags

hasAccess.description: Whether the requester has access to the team
hasAccess.title: Has Access

isMember.description: Whether the requester is a team member
isMember.title: Is Member

isPending.description: Whether the team membership is pending
isPending.title: Is Pending

UpdateTeamInformationByOrganizationIdRes.title: UpdateTeamInformationByOrganizationIdResponse
